title: Old Diary
description: Never end your search to break,
And never let your thoughts be fake.
Let the colors lead your mind,
Free your soul from all-time twine,
But your goals are still aligned.
Don't be humbled, don't you fear,
This rite'll not leave you seared,
And when the world around you smears
Just accept this gift and steer."
- Words of passion that each of the Great Surface Explorer recieves after undergoing severe mutations to be able to walk outside of the Spectrum Depths
